spans.s:
हिल् हिल् (connected with rt. हेल्, q. v.),
cl. 6. P. हिलति, जिहेल, &c., to sport
amorously, dally, wanton, express amorous inclina-
tion.

हिल-मोचि, इस्, or हिल-मोची or हिलमोचिका, f.
the pot-herb Hingtsha Repens.
हिलीसमुद्र हिली-समुद्र, N. of a place.
हिल्ल हिल्ल, अस्, m. a kind of bird (= शरारि).

हील हील, अम्, n. (perhaps connected with
rt. हिल्), semen virile.

हिल्लोल हिल्लोल, अस्, m. (connected with
हिन्दोल, q. v.), a wave, surge; a whim; a particular
form of sexual union; one of the Rāgas or personified
musical modes, (for हिन्दोल, q. v.)

हिल्लोलय, Nom. P. हिल्लोलयति, &c., to swing
or rock or roll about (= हिन्दोलय).

हिल्वला हिल्वला, आस्, f. pl., N. of five small
stars in the head of the Nakṣatra Mṛga-śiras; [cf.
इल्वलास्.]

हीलुक, अम्, n. a kind of rum or spirit distilled
from molasses.
